title: Define provenance model
scope: Generate-origin provenance links 420Hz product state to canonical 420AI/Compute/Creative references using commitments and native IDs without publishing private payloads or inventing authority.

fields.name: creatorAccountRef
fields.rule: account/controller reference only; no signing authority

fields.name: providerId
fields.rule: record only canonical provider reference actually bound to execution

fields.name: requestCommitment
fields.rule: commitment only; never plaintext prompt/lyrics/reference media

fields.name: resultCommitment
fields.rule: must match verified canonical AI result

fields.name: resultManifestHash
fields.rule: must match verified canonical AI result manifest

fields.name: aiDisclosureClass
fields.rule: one of HUMAN, AI_ASSISTED, AI_GENERATED, AI_DERIVATIVE

fields.name: declarationCommitment
fields.rule: binds reviewed disclosure declaration under exact policy version

fields.name: sourceAuthorizationRefs
fields.rule: proves linkage only; 420Hz does not grant permission

fields.name: voiceConsentRefs
fields.rule: must reference explicit consent evidence; absence blocks such claim

fields.name: artifactCommitments
fields.rule: commitments to selected output artifacts; raw bytes may remain private

fields.name: creativeProvenanceCommitment
fields.rule: exact commitment supplied as/into Creative provenanceHash semantics

fields.name: authorizationManifestCommitment
fields.rule: exact source/authorization manifest commitment supplied to Recording registration where applicable

fields.name: publishedProvenanceCommitment
fields.rule: final published commitment for exact Recording/version

fields.name: supersedesProvenanceRecordId
fields.rule: correction edge; historical record remains immutable

neverPublicPlaintext: model secrets/private weights unless intentionally public
privacy.rule: A commitment/reference proves linkage only to the extent the owning system and verification policy support; it does not reveal or validate hidden plaintext by itself.

lineage: source Work/Recording/License/authorization and voice-consent references when applicable
derivativeRules: AI_DERIVATIVE provenance must include at least one sourceWorkId or sourceRecordingId and an applicable sourceAuthorizationRef.
Where permission is represented by a Creative License, preserve native LicenseId in sourceLicenseIds.
source IDs and authorization references are provenance links, not a grant created by 420Hz.
AI transformation permission and AI training permission remain distinct and must never share one implied authorization flag.
voiceRules: A synthetic voice/persona identity claim requires explicit voiceConsentRefs before REVIEWED and publication.
voiceConsentRefs must identify a qualified consent source/commitment; a model name or provider claim is insufficient.
HZ-GCA-1.5 records the reference shape only; detailed consent policy/validation is frozen in HZ-GCA-1.6.
correctionRules: A correction creates a new revision/provenanceRecordId or revision edge that references supersedesProvenanceRecordId.
Historical request/result/source/disclosure commitments are never overwritten in place.
If canonical external evidence is later disputed/revoked, current presentation may mark status/restriction but retains historical provenance lineage.

Work.provenanceHash: must be derived from/bind creativeProvenanceCommitment for the exact reviewed provenance package
Work.provenanceClass: must be chosen under Creative Protocol semantics and does not replace the HZ disclosure class

Recording.provenanceHash: must bind the exact reviewed provenance package
Recording.authorizationManifestHash: must bind applicable source/consent/authorization references where required
Recording.mediaManifestHash: remains media/storage manifest authority and does not substitute for provenance
Recording.recordingClass: AI_DERIVATIVE must remain consistent with HZ-GCA-1.4 disclosure and source provenance

failureRules: missing required provenance before REVIEWED blocks REVIEWED
AI_DERIVATIVE without source provenance/authorization blocks REVIEWED and publication
synthetic identity claim without required voiceConsentRefs blocks REVIEWED/publication
missing Creative handoff commitments blocks REGISTERED
plaintext protected payloads in public provenance are invalid
provider/model marketing claims cannot substitute for canonical AI/job/result references
in-place mutation of published provenance is invalid
invariants: HZGCA-PROV-001 every Generate-origin published Recording has a versioned provenance record linked to the exact output
HZGCA-PROV-002 provenance preserves native external IDs and never creates competing AI, Compute or Creative identities
HZGCA-PROV-003 request/result provenance uses canonical commitments/references and never requires public plaintext prompts or private audio
HZGCA-PROV-004 aiJobId, modelVersionId, resultCommitment and resultManifestHash must agree with the owning 420AI job/version
HZGCA-PROV-005 provider/compute references are recorded only when actually bound by canonical execution
HZGCA-PROV-006 disclosure class and declaration commitment are bound under the exact HZ-GCA-1.4 policy version
HZGCA-PROV-007 AI_DERIVATIVE provenance includes source identity plus applicable authorization references
HZGCA-PROV-008 source WorkId, RecordingId and LicenseId remain native Creative IDs
HZGCA-PROV-009 synthetic voice/persona claims require explicit consent references and cannot rely on model/provider naming alone
HZGCA-PROV-010 provenance references do not themselves grant copyright, license, consent, payment, custody or governance authority
HZGCA-PROV-011 AI transformation authorization remains distinct from AI training permission
HZGCA-PROV-012 REVIEWED requires complete required provenance for the exact selected output
HZGCA-PROV-013 REGISTERED requires exact Creative handoff commitments and native CreatorProfile/Work/Recording linkage
HZGCA-PROV-014 PUBLISHED binds final provenance to the exact Recording/version and preserves historical lineage
HZGCA-PROV-015 provenance corrections are append-only/versioned and never overwrite historical commitments
HZGCA-PROV-016 public provenance excludes protected plaintext/secrets while permitting hashes, commitments and canonical IDs
HZGCA-PROV-017 provenanceClass, rightsStatus, mediaManifestHash and disclosureClass remain distinct semantic fields
HZGCA-PROV-018 later dispute/restriction may alter current availability/status but cannot erase historical provenance
exitCriteria: 420AI model/job/request/result/provider/compute references and authority are explicit
disclosure is bound to provenance under exact policy version
source Work/Recording/License/authorization and voice-consent reference rules are explicit
Creative Work/Recording provenance and authorization handoff is explicit
correction/versioning and dispute-history semantics are explicit
machine verifier enforces required fields, derivative/voice gates, native IDs and privacy/authority invariants
no ABI, deployment, live provider or testnet claim is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.6 through HZ-GCA-1.20
